title: Use of Label-free Optical Biosensors to Detect Modulation of Potassium Channels by G-protein Coupled Receptors
protocol: Culture cells in appropriate media for greater than 2 but less than 10 passages before use.
Add 500 μg/ml Geneticin to HEK-293 cells stably expressing rat Slack-B protein to select for expression of the Slack channel.
Dissociate cells from dishes with a 0.25% trypsin-EDTA solution when they reach 70-90% confluence.
Prepare a working solution of fibronectin in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) at a final concentration of 5 μg/ml by adding 100 μl to 20 ml PBS for a 200-fold dilution.
Aliquot the prepared fibronectin solution and store at -20°C.
Prepare a 5% stock solution of heat-inactivated ovalbumin in sterile water.
Heat-inactivate the ovalbumin solution for 30 min at 60°C.
Cool the ovalbumin solution to room temperature after heating.
Sterile filter the cooled ovalbumin solution.
Aliquot the 5% ovalbumin solution and store at 4°C.
Prepare a 2% working solution of ovalbumin by diluting the 5% stock solution into PBS.
Hydrate the TiO2 plate with 20.0 μl/well of sterile tissue culture grade water for 15 min.
Wash plate once with 50.0 μl PBS per well.
Add 20.0 μl of the fibronectin working solution to each well and incubate for 2 hr at room temperature to create the ECM.
Wash plate once with 50.0 μl PBS per well.
Add 40.0 μl of the ovalbumin working solution to each well and incubate overnight at 4 °C to block the plate.
Wash plate three times with 50.0 μl PBS per well.
Remove growth media from the cells and add trypsin to dislodge the cells from the plate.
Collect the cells and centrifuge at 1,000 x g for 1 min.
Remove the trypsin medium and resuspend cells in growth medium.
Determine the concentration of the cells using a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Dilute cells to achieve the desired number of cells per well (e.g., 1,000 cells/well) in a volume of 50.0 μl of growth medium.
Seed diluted cells onto ECM-coated biosensor plates.
Incubate seeded cells overnight in growth medium at 37 °C under air/5% CO2.
Remove growth media from the cells.
Wash cells once with Hanks Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS).
Add 25.0 µl of HBSS to each well.
Place the biosensor plate on the BIND Scanner and allow cells to equilibrate to room temperature for 1-2 hours.
Prepare a compound plate containing ligands in 2x desired final concentration.
Add 25.0 µl of compound solutions to each well for wells A1-P12, making a total volume of 50.0 µl per well.
Take a baseline measurement with the Scanner system for wells A1-P12 using maximum resolution of 3.75 µm/pixel for the central 1.5 mm of each well.
Take a baseline measurement of wells A13-P24.
Add 25.0 µl of compound solutions to each well for wells A13-P24.
Take a post-compound addition measurement for wells A1-P12.
Repeat the post-compound addition measurement for wells A13-P24.
Open the BIND assay data for the baseline measurement in Windows.
Click the "Grid Editor" button to enable cell selection.
Set parameters in "Cell Finder" so that cells are distinguishable from the background of the biosensor.
Export the cell map file which contains the "Cell Finder" data for the baseline measurement.
Import the cell map from the baseline measurement into the "Baseliner" plug-in.
Calculate the shift in PWV between the background and post compound data using the software.
Select "Δ Cell Mean" for the output of the mean shift in PWV for cells.
